item.title: Tellus Radiometric — raw airborne flight-line data source files
item.subtitle: Geology and Geophysics / GSNI, Tellus, BGS
item.description: Raw airborne gamma-ray spectrometer readings along each Tellus flight line — K, U, Th window counts plus total count, before gridding into the radiometric maps already on this site. Useful for re-processing or quality-assessing the gridded products.
